name: Mara Fenwick
blurb: Three championships and still tables an axe on turn two. Nobody blocks Kor Skyfisher against Mara twice.

name: Oyelaran Dosunmu
blurb: Founding member. Wrote the club's first sideboard guide on the back of a beer mat, which is still taped behind the bar.

name: Priya Shenoy
blurb: The only pilot in the club who can explain the Tron mirror without losing the room. Undefeated on League Mondays this year.

name: Declan Fitzwilliam
blurb: Older than the club's second venue. Still sleeves his artifacts in the same battered sleeves from 2019.

name: Tomasz Wieczorek
blurb: Came for one demo night, stayed forever. Holds the club record for most creatures cast in a single turn: fourteen.

name: Aoife Lundqvist
blurb: Quiet at the table, loud on the scoreboard. Three-time Autumn Championship finalist.
